categories.main_business_segments: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and maintenance services of graphite materials, graphite products, graphite equipment, and complete systems. Key products include special and chemical-grade graphite materials, graphite synthesis furnaces, graphite heat exchangers, graphite reaction towers, and related accessories. These products are mainly used in chemical production processes such as synthesis, heat exchange, and decomposition across various industries including chlor-alkali, polysilicon, epoxy chloropropane, organosilicon, phosphorus chemical, pesticides, pharmaceuticals, fine chemicals, new materials, environmental protection, fluorine chemical, zirconium, and chemical fiber sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced graphite material technologies including high-efficiency energy-saving graphite synthesis and heat recovery integration, chlorine-hydrogen gas combustion technology, automatic ignition systems, and high-temperature flue gas cooling technology. Manufacturing involves complex processes such as calcination, molding, baking, impregnation, graphitization, and machining. The company also develops proprietary technologies like calcium chloride extraction for deep hydrochloric acid parsing and multi-effect evaporation for energy savings. It emphasizes automated and intelligent manufacturing, including CFD simulation for design optimization and impregnation process improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are large state-owned enterprises and listed companies in downstream chemical industries such as chlor-alkali, polysilicon, epoxy chloropropane, organosilicon, pesticides, pharmaceuticals, fine chemicals, and environmental protection. It maintains stable relationships with major clients including China National Chemical Corporation, Zhongtai Group, Yangnong Group, Xinfeng Group, Xingfa Group, Yihua Group, GCL Group, Jinchuan Group, and others. The products serve multiple chemical sub-sectors requiring corrosion-resistant, high-temperature, and high-efficiency equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant market presence in regions such as East China, Northwest China, North China, Central China, South China, and Northeast China. It also has growing international sales, including exports to markets like India and Southeast Asia. The company has established professional after-sales service offices in key regions including Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia to support customers locally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the graphite industry supply chain. It manufactures graphite equipment and systems for chemical production processes and has recently expanded upstream by investing in graphite raw material production through its wholly-owned subsidiary Inner Mongolia Xingqiu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd., which produces special and chemical-grade graphite materials. This vertical integration enhances synergy between materials and equipment production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses strategically on innovation in energy-saving and environmental protection technologies, intelligent manufacturing, and integrated system solutions. R&D priorities include improving graphite material properties, developing high-efficiency graphite heat exchangers, advanced impregnation techniques, and flue gas treatment technologies. It actively pursues new product development in areas such as graphite carbon crystal coolers and sulfuric acid concentration systems, aiming to enhance product performance, reduce energy consumption, and support circular economy initiatives. The company also emphasizes standardization and digitalization to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized graphite equipment, materials, and system solutions to industrial customers. The company also earns income from maintenance and after-sales services. Pricing strategies are cost-plus and differentiated based on product type, customer credit, contract terms, and service agreements. Sales contracts typically include stages of prepayment, delivery, installation, commissioning, and warranty retention. The company also generates financial income from investments of idle funds and convertible bond issuance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer and innovator in the high-end graphite chemical equipment sector. It holds national recognitions such as manufacturing 'single champion' demonstration enterprise and 'specialized and new' small giant enterprise. The company competes by leveraging advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines, and integrated service capabilities. It maintains strong relationships with major chemical industry clients and engineering firms, differentiating itself through energy-efficient, corrosion-resistant, and long-life graphite equipment. The industry is characterized by high technical barriers and customization requirements, limiting new entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 770.8 million, representing an 18.35% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 147.7 million, up 4.27%. The company’s total assets grew by 37.11% to RMB 2.85 billion, and net assets increased by 12.34% to RMB 1.52 billion. R&D investment accounted for 6.23% of revenue. The company issued RMB 620 million in convertible bonds in 2023 to support growth and innovation. Despite strong revenue growth, profit growth was moderated by fixed costs from new upstream graphite material production and bond interest expenses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-efficiency, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly graphite equipment with superior corrosion resistance, thermal conductivity, and durability. Its products integrate advanced technologies such as high heat recovery rates, automated ignition, and intelligent control systems, enabling customers to reduce operational costs and emissions. The company offers a comprehensive 'materials, equipment, systems, and services' integrated solution, enhancing customer value through customized design, reliable performance, and professional after-sales support. Its strategic upstream integration in graphite material production further strengthens product quality and cost competitiveness.
